title: Blog Post Drafter
desc: Turns a rough topic and outline into a full first draft in your voice.

title: Ruthless Line Editor
desc: Tightens a draft for clarity and cuts unnecessary words, sentence by sentence.
template:
Act as a ruthless but constructive line editor. Edit the text below for {{focus}}.

Rules:
- Preserve the author's voice and intent.
- Cut redundant words and passive voice.
- Flag (don't silently fix) any factual claims that need a source.
- Return the edited version, then a short bullet list of the biggest changes made and why.

TEXT:
{{text}}

title: Rapid Topic Briefing
desc: Produces a structured, skimmable briefing on any unfamiliar topic.
template:
Give me a structured briefing on: {{topic}}

Format:
1. One-paragraph plain-language overview
2. Key facts / numbers I should know
3. Common misconceptions
4. Open debates or unresolved questions
5. 3 follow-up questions worth exploring next

Depth level: {{depth}}. Cite the type of source where relevant (e.g. "industry report," "academic study") without inventing specific citations.

title: Document Summarizer
desc: Condenses a long document into decision-ready takeaways.
template:
Summarize the following document for someone who has {{minutes}} minutes.

Output:
- 3-sentence executive summary
- Key takeaways as bullets
- Any risks, caveats, or open questions
- One recommended next action

DOCUMENT:
{{document}}

title: Code Reviewer
desc: Reviews a code snippet for bugs, readability, and edge cases.
template:
Review this {{language}} code as a senior engineer doing a pull request review.

Check for: correctness, edge cases, readability, naming, and performance concerns. Do not rewrite the whole file — give specific, line-referenced comments and only show corrected snippets for issues you flag.

CODE:
{{code}}

title: Bug Diagnosis Assistant
desc: Walks through likely causes of a bug systematically before suggesting fixes.

title: Weekly Priority Planner
desc: Turns a messy task list into a focused, ordered weekly plan.

title: Decision Framework
desc: Structures a hard decision using explicit criteria instead of gut feel.

title: Email Rewriter
desc: Rewrites a rough email draft to match a specific tone and goal.

title: Difficult Conversation Scripter
desc: Drafts talking points for a sensitive conversation, with objection handling.

title: Social Post Generator
desc: Turns one idea into platform-specific social copy variants.

title: Landing Page Copy Builder
desc: Drafts structured landing page copy from a product description.

title: UX Critique
desc: Gives structured, actionable feedback on an interface description or screenshot.
template:
Critique this interface as a senior product designer: {{description}}

Evaluate: clarity of primary action, visual hierarchy, accessibility concerns, and consistency. Give a short list of the top 3 highest-impact changes, ranked by effort vs. impact.
vars: describe the screen or paste a link/notes

title: Support Reply Drafter
desc: Drafts an empathetic, on-brand support reply to a customer message.

title: Cold Outreach Drafter
desc: Writes a short, personalized first-touch outreach message.

title: Daily Standup Summarizer
desc: Turns rough end-of-day notes into a clean standup update.
template:
Turn these rough notes into a standup update: {{notes}}

Format:
- Yesterday: ...
- Today: ...
- Blockers: ...
Keep it under 80 words total.

title: Meeting Notes → Action Items
desc: Extracts clear owners and deadlines from messy meeting notes.
template:
Convert these meeting notes into action items: {{notes}}

For each action item, extract: task, owner (if mentioned, else "unassigned"), and deadline (if mentioned, else "not set"). Then list any open questions that were raised but not resolved.

title: Literature / Source Comparator
desc: Compares multiple sources or viewpoints on the same question side by side.
